name: Booking or Online Store
description: Take bookings or sell online, with features shaped around how your business runs.
features: Online bookings or a product shop
A walkthrough so you can run it yourself
pageIntro: Let customers book appointments or buy from you any time of day. This package covers everything in a business website, plus online bookings or a product shop shaped around how your business runs.
whoItsFor: Salons, clinics, tour operators and other appointment-based businesses, and local makers or shops that want to sell online.

details.heading: Bookings
details.text: Customers pick a service and a time that suits them, and you get a notification. Reminders and deposits can be added if they suit your business.

details.heading: Online store
details.text: Product pages, a cart and secure checkout, with local pickup, delivery or shipping options. I'll show you how to add products and manage orders yourself.

details.heading: Pricing
details.text: Every booking or store project is a little different, so the price starts from $1,499 and you get a fixed quote once we've talked through what you need.
